review_candidates.title: 2nd Line IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Role As a 2nd Line IT Support Engineer, you'll be responsible for: Acting as the primary technical escalation point for 1st Line IT Support. Supporting and administering Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online. Maintaining accurate technical documentation. You should have demonstrable hands-on experience in areas such as: Microsoft 365 administration. Networking and troubleshooting. Firewall and switch administration. Infrastructure troubleshooting and problem management.
eligibility_evidence: We're looking for an experienced 2nd Line IT Support Engineer to join an established IT team supporting approximately 500 employees across a national branch network.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on technical role and you'll become the primary escalation point for the 1st Line team, while working alongside an existing 2nd Line Technician on infrastructure support and change projects. You should have demonstrable hands-on experience in areas such as: Microsoft 365 administration. You don't need to be an expert in every technology listed, but you must be able to demonstrate genuine hands-on technical depth in the relevant areas.
